title: ‘It’s Our Duty’ to Call Trump’s Crackdown Fascist, Says Top Election Official
author: Asawin Suebsaeng
content:
Early this year, the Trump administration's crackdowns across the country were
getting so bad that **[Adrian Fontes](https://zeteo.com/p/live-q-and-a-today-
meet-the-man-fighting)** , Arizona's Democratic secretary of state, actually
considered carrying around his passport, in case he was stopped by an armed
ICE agent on the streets of Phoenix.

The fact that Fontes - a Latino man and one of his state's most prominent and
visible elected officials - even contemplated that is a sign of how far we've
fallen in such a short period of time during the second Donald Trump
presidency. And as Team Trump mounts its all-out, nationwide onslaught
[against free and fair elections](https://zeteo.com/p/how-to-stop-trump-from-
interfering), the crucial battleground state of Arizona quickly
[became](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/may/03/arizona-state-
secretary-trump-elections) one of the president's central targets for
attempted election rigging.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

Fontes joined **Zeteo 's** senior political correspondent, **Asawin
Suebsaeng** , for a Town Hall discussion with **Zeteo** subscribers, during
which Arizona's top election official discussed his state's ongoing efforts to
fight back against MAGA election meddling, the American **" revolutionary
spirit"** that gives him hope in Trumpian times, and why he thinks it is **"
our duty"** to call President Trump and Republicans' anti-democratic policies
**" fascist."**
